install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

KUBECTL_VERSION="${1:-}"
if [ -z "$KUBECTL_VERSION" ]; then
  KUBECTL_VERSION="$(curl -fsSL https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt)"
fi

arch="$(uname -m)"
case "$arch" in
  x86_64) karch="amd64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) karch="arm64" ;;
  armv7l|armhf) karch="arm" ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: unsupported architecture ($arch)" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

echo "==> Installing kubectl ${KUBECTL_VERSION} (${karch})"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ca-certificates curl
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y ca-certificates curl
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Sy --noconfirm ca-certificates curl
fi

workdir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/kubectl-install.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$workdir"' EXIT
cd "$workdir"

curl -fsSLo kubectl "https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KUBECTL_VERSION}/bin/linux/${karch}/kubectl"
curl -fsSLo kubectl.sha256 "https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KUBECTL_VERSION}/bin/linux/${karch}/kubectl.sha256"
echo "$(cat kubectl.sha256)  kubectl" | sha256sum -c -
install -m 0755 kubectl /usr/local/bin/kubectl

echo "==> Verifying installation"
kubectl version --client
echo "==> kubectl ${KUBECTL_VERSION} installed at $(command -v kubectl)"
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "==> Removing kubectl"
rm -f /usr/local/bin/kubectl
echo "==> kubectl removed"
